about: The full three-minute film's transcript and scene descriptions, from its production plan (cut-plan.json and narration-plan.json). The narration is the captions' text word for word, which tests/test_build_site.py checks. scripts/build_site.py renders it into site/film/index.html.
title: The full film: transcript and scene descriptions | ta-amps
description: The three-minute Eranos film's transcript and scene descriptions, in four acts: spare tokens for good, why AI work is frustratingly dumb and the fix, any project and any agent, and how the film itself was made.
heading: The full film: transcript and scene descriptions
lead: Three minutes in four acts. Every line of narration, word for word as the captions give it, with when it plays and a description of what is on screen, and the storyboard from the draft run that came before the final cut. The film plays on the home page.
audio_description: A separate audio-described cut is not available yet. Until then, this page is the film's text alternative.

acts.name: Why AI work is frustratingly dumb, and the fix

lines.words: If your AI plan has tokens left over at the end of the month…
lines.picture: A month's AI plan meter; the unused part fills with token tiles that lift off.
lines.on_screen: This month's AI plan · used · left over

lines.words: …Eranos puts them to work for nonprofits. Spare tokens, for good.
lines.picture: The tiles fly into the Eranos mark; the title card.
lines.on_screen: Eranos · Spare tokens for good. · Your unused AI capacity, doing real work for nonprofits.

lines.words: Nonprofits say what they need, in plain words.
lines.picture: Eight real-world nonprofit needs in plain words (synthetic examples), sorted by the first step into two routes: public information, finished and cited by donated agents; work on their own files, a kit their own agent runs. The 3:00 cut adds one typed need sorted into its parts.
lines.on_screen: In plain words · first step: sort and split · finished, cited · a kit their own agent runs

lines.words: Public research comes back finished and cited. Work on their own files becomes a kit their own agent runs.
lines.on_screen: In plain words · first step: sort and split · finished, cited · a kit their own agent runs

lines.words: Anyone can help. Open Eranos, pick an open task, and hand it to your own AI agent.
lines.picture: The live /help page: connect your agent, copy a starting brief, the open tasks.
lines.on_screen: eranos.ta-amps.workers.dev/help

lines.words: Your agent claims the task. Only one agent works on it at a time, and every step gets a receipt.
lines.picture: Volunteer A's recorded terminal session in the local run: list tasks, claim the scope check, pass it, claim the build, with lease and claim receipts.
lines.on_screen: claimed · only volunteer-a can submit · claim receipt

lines.words: It doesn't start from scratch. It reuses checked pieces from seed packs, and tests the kit on made-up cases.
lines.picture: The build from checked pieces of a reviewed kit, the 8 deterministic checks and 2 made-up cases; the kit's parts land as nouns; the submit receipt.
lines.on_screen: 8 of 8 checks pass · receipt

lines.words: A different volunteer's agent reviews it. The builder can never approve its own kit.
lines.picture: Volunteer A tries to approve its own kit and is refused; volunteer B claims the review, re-runs the checks, approves and publishes.
lines.on_screen: refused · two-step rule · approved · published

lines.words: Sensitive kits wait for a person at a nonprofit to sign off.
lines.picture: The live /nonprofits page's person-only list, ending with steward sign-off on sensitive kits; then the local run's steward (a scripted stand-in for a person) signs off and the review publishes the kit.
lines.on_screen: Sign-off on sensitive kits, by a nonprofit steward · signed off · published

lines.words: Now the nonprofit has a free, reviewed kit. It does the busywork, and a person makes every decision about a person.
lines.picture: The published kit's page in the local catalog: what the agent drafts and what stays with a person, then the review receipts.
lines.on_screen: Agent drafts · Person only · Review receipts

lines.words: AI is smart. The way we use it is frustratingly dumb.
lines.picture: The overview deck's opening line: AI is smart; the way we use it is frustratingly dumb.
lines.on_screen: AI is smart. The way we use it is frustratingly dumb.

lines.words: It doesn't know what's new. It rewrites what already exists. It needs babysitting on long jobs. And training alone doesn't fix it.
lines.picture: The overview deck's problem slide, built card by card: three problems, then training alone doesn't fix it.
lines.on_screen: It doesn't know what's new · It rewrites what already exists · It needs babysitting · Training alone doesn't fix it

lines.words: Everything is nouns and verbs. Nouns are reusable things: code, knowledge, results, even an agent's whole setup. Verbs are jobs any agent can claim, do and prove.
lines.picture: The overview deck's nouns-and-verbs slide, built: nouns, then verbs, then surfaces and infrastructure.
lines.on_screen: Everything is nouns and verbs

lines.words: Feeds turn what's new into nouns. Search and retrieval bring the right ones to any agent as it works, and Herma, the shim, can answer with no model call. So agents reuse instead of rewriting.
lines.picture: The overview deck's fixes slide, built row by row, with a real search_nouns and recall_execution call that this video's own compose verb made in its store.
lines.on_screen: Feeds · Search and retrieval · Verbs on one shared queue

lines.words: And Tessera splits big jobs into small verbs that many workers claim, check and finish, each with a receipt.
lines.on_screen: Feeds · Search and retrieval · Verbs on one shared queue

lines.words: Training still helps. On one synthetic task each, small Llama models went from 12 to 51 percent and 52 to 73, and Glimmer 30B from 93 to 99 on a fresh, pre-registered test.
lines.picture: The overview deck's learning slide, built card by card, with its caveat.

lines.words: Two surfaces: Eranos and Agora. Two pieces of infrastructure: Tessera and Herma. And seed packs to share them.
lines.picture: The overview deck's map slide: two surfaces, two pieces of infrastructure, seed packs.
lines.on_screen: Eranos · Agora · Tessera · Herma · seed packs

lines.words: The same nouns and verbs fit almost any project: grant reports, literature reviews, checked data pipelines.
lines.picture: Agora's live use-cases page.
lines.on_screen: Use cases

lines.words: To connect any agent, copy the instructions from Agora. It finds the verbs it can do, claims one, and reports back with a receipt.
lines.picture: Agora's live Agent compatible banner and its Copy instructions button; Tessera's live tool count, read from its public agent pages.
lines.on_screen: Copy instructions · 37 tools

lines.words: Or make your own seed pack, and submit it.
lines.picture: The roll-your-own deck's make-a-seed-pack slide, then the pull-back into the board.
lines.on_screen: Make a seed pack

lines.words: This entire video was made from nouns and verbs, claimed and finished by workers on Tessera, with a receipt for every step.
lines.picture: Pull back from the picture into a 'this video' noun tile; the board of this video's verbs and receipts, read from the local production Tessera store.
lines.on_screen: THIS VIDEO · NOUNS AND VERBS

lines.words: Start at Agora, and point your agent at Eranos.
lines.picture: Agora's home and Eranos, with both addresses.
lines.on_screen: Start at Agora · Point your agent at Eranos

note: Narration is an AI voice (Kokoro, af_heart). Every example in the film uses synthetic data, and every number comes from a measured, synthetic task.
